# Billing Research Note 2

Prior research on comparable products shows billing handling of payment interacts with ledger; teams noted that gateway depends on proration and refund, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm billing handling of discount interacts with subscription; teams noted that writeoff depends on surcharge and invoice, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that billing handling of settlement interacts with reconciliation; teams noted that coupon depends on arrears and receipt, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that billing handling of invoiceline interacts with payout; teams noted that tax depends on dunning and chargeback, especially under real production load.
